changes: Rebuilt against Territorial.io 2.16.46 — the client works with the current game update again.

The automation's game-internal lookups (border tiles, tile ownership, attack sending and cancelling) were re-derived for this game build and are now verified at build time, so a future game update fails the build instead of silently breaking targeting.
Picked up the FX Client 0.6.29 fixes: gamemode-aware IP highlighting, player names no longer parsed as HTML, and the obsolete hostname-detection patch removed.
